headword: {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}
gloss: service life; useful life; durability period

definitions.gloss: service life; useful life; expected lifespan (of equipment or assets)
definitions.explanation: The expected number of years that equipment, buildings, or other assets can be used before needing replacement. Used both in everyday contexts and in accounting for depreciation purposes.

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}の{耐用年数|たいようねんすう}は{十|じゅう}{年|ねん}だ。
examples.english: This machine has a service life of ten years.

examples.japanese: エアコンの{耐用年数|たいようねんすう}を{過|す}ぎたので、{買|か}い{替|か}えた。
examples.english: The air conditioner exceeded its service life, so I replaced it.

examples.japanese: {税法|ぜいほう}で{定|さだ}められた{耐用年数|たいようねんすう}に{基|もと}づいて{減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: Depreciation is calculated based on the service life defined in the tax code.

notes:
A practical term for the expected useful lifespan of equipment and assets. Composed of {耐用|たいよう} (durable use) + {年数|ねんすう} (number of years). Used in everyday conversations about appliances and in business/accounting for calculating depreciation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}が{過|す}ぎる: to exceed service life
- {法定|ほうてい}{耐用年数|たいようねんすう}: legally mandated service life
- {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}を{超|こ}える: to surpass service life
- {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}が{長|なが}い/{短|みじか}い: long/short service life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寿命|じゅみょう}: lifespan — used for people, animals, and products
- {使用期限|しようきげん}: expiration date, use-by date — for consumables
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}: durability — the quality of lasting
- {減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}: depreciation — the accounting method that uses {耐用年数|たいようねんすう}
